We are seeking a motivated and innovative Research Intern to develop and prototype multimodal AI agents that can interpret and reason across diverse Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) data, designing creative new workflows for AI in Construction. This internship will focus on Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and knowledge graphs to create intelligent agents capable of understanding AEC documentation, images, and sensor data to autonomously execute construction management tasks. As an intern with Autodesk Research, you’ll collaborate with a global team working at the intersection of AI, robotics, and construction technology. Your work will directly contribute to advancing digital twins, multimodal reasoning, and scalable AI systems for the AEC industry. Responsibilities Multimodal AI Agent Development: Design and prototype AI agents using LLMs, vision-language models, and multi-agent frameworks. Focus on integrating agent protocols to enable robust interactions between agents and external tools (e.g., APIs, databases, and resources). Prototype AI Solutions in Construction Project: Build a functional AI agent prototype, including demos that showcase capabilities in querying, data analysis, and inter-agent interactions in a real-world AEC project. Research and Implement Data Analysis Techniques: Explore graph querying methods and multimodal data to interpret and combine textual, visual, and sensor data from construction sources. Address key challenges, including handling domain-specific nuances in AEC data. Conduct Experiments and Present Findings: Perform hands-on research on AI agent architectures for construction applications and present results to the team through reports, demos, or potential contributions to academic papers. Minimum Qualifications Pursuing a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning/AI, Robotics, or a related field, with familiarity in AEC domains. Strong proficiency in Python and experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, PyTorch, or similar for building agents and models. Hands-on experience with LLMs, vision-language models (e.g., GPT-4V, Claude, Gemini), and graph tools (e.g., Neo4j, GraphQL, or similar). Understanding of multimodal data processing, including techniques for combining textual, visual, and sensor inputs. Solid grasp of agent protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol, Agent2Agent Protocol) and experience with external tool integrations (e.g., APIs). Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with a passion for innovative technology in construction. ai.title: Stagiaire aux opérations d'entrepôt, Longueuil Molson Coors Longueuil, QC Salary not specified Un toast à un avenir exceptionnel ! Chez Molson Coors, nous relevons de grands défis et défions le statu quo. Avec un héritage de fierté et d'excellence, un portefeuille incroyable de bières, de alcoolisée, de spiritueux et de marques sans alcool, et une vision audacieuse pour notre avenir... nous sommes sur la voie de la transformation de l'industrie des boissons. Cela nécessite des individus remarquables qui sont curieux, tenaces et qui n'ont jamais peur d'échouer en avançant. Nous recherchons, valorisons et respectons les perspectives et expériences uniques de chacun, sachant que nous sommes plus forts ensemble. Nous collaborons en équipe et célébrons les succès de chacun. Pour des carrières brassées avec passion, et des histoires qui laissent leur empreinte. À la tête du brassage : Dans le rôle de stagiaire aux opérations d’entrepôt travaillant à la brasserie de Longueuil , vous ferez partie de notre programme des jeunes talents . Ce programme est un stage d’été destiné aux étudiants de premier cycle chez Molson Coors entreprise de boissons, offrant une immersion dans l’industrie des boissons. Les stagiaires sont impliqués dans la résolution de problèmes réels et bénéficient d’opportunités sociales et éducatives en collaboration avec d’autres stagiaires. Le programme est à temps plein du mois de mai 2026 au mois d'août 2026. Vous allez faire partie de l’équipe de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de la distribution au Québec, votre gestionnaire de stage vous guidera tout au long de votre parcours afin de vous aider à vous familiariser avec les opérations et l’environnement de travail. Ce qui mijote dans nos cuves : Vos responsabilités seront variées: vous contribuerez à plusieurs projets clés à améliorer nos performances opérationnelles et notre efficacité. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’exploitation (gestionnaire, trio, it) et d’analyse pour : Optimiser les tableaux de bords KPI : revoir et automatiser les outils de suivi des performances pour une prise de décision plus rapide et efficace. Améliorer le processus de retour des produits du marché : identifier et mettre en œuvre des solutions pour réduire les délais et simplifier les étapes. Optimiser la prise d’inventaire : proposer et tester des méthodes pour améliorer la précision et la rapidité des inventaires. D’autre part, dans le cadre de votre stage chez Molson Coors entreprise de boissons, vous aurez à : Analyser les processus actuels et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration. Créer et maintenir des outils et rapports dans la suite Office, principalement avec Excel (macros, tableaux croisés dynamiques). Participer à l’implémentation d’initiatives d’amélioration continue. Assurer une documentation claire des nouveaux processus et formations. Collaborer avec les équipes pour déployer des projets sur SAP EWM S/4 HANA. Les ingrédients qui font la différence : Vous devez être étudiant de premier cycle (inscrit à des cours de premier cycle) pendant le stage d'été pour participer au programme des jeunes talents. Vous êtes inscrit à temps plein au baccalauréat en gestion des opérations ou dans un programme similaire (logistique, génie industriel, ou domaine connexe), et vous avez déjà complété votre première ou deuxième année d'études. Vous êtes motivé(e) à mettre en valeur vos compétences en leadership, en animation de groupe et en gestion de projets. Vous avez un excellent sens de l'organisation, de la gestion des priorités et une forte capacité à prendre des initiatives. Vous aimez les défis. Vous réalisez des projets complexes rapidement et habilement grâce à votre compréhension des priorités Vous établissez des relations et collaborez pour arriver au résultat désiré Vous assumez la responsabilité des résultats – agissez avec intégrité et respect des engagements Vous avez la soif d’apprendre – vous êtes toujours à la recherche de moyens d’apprendre et de s’entraider à croître Du bonheur en prime : Expérience enrichissante et unique : Nous offrons une formation initiale à Toronto, suivie d'une semaine à notre usine de Milwaukee, aux États-Unis, pour conclure votre stage avec tous les participants du programme des jeunes talents. Opportunités de carrière : Les stagiaires ayant complété avec succès le programme des jeunes talents sont considérés pour des postes à temps plein au sein de Molson Coors entreprise de boissons, à l'obtention de leur diplôme. Aide au logement : Une aide au logement est disponible pour les candidats qui remplissent les critères d'éligibilité. Chez Molson Coors, nous nous engageons à respecter des objectifs ambitieux et à avoir un impact positif sur nos priorités environnementales et sociales. Pub sur place, l’accès à des vêtements et accessoires de marque tendance et de supers événements phares, sans oublier, bien sûr… de la bière et des boissons gratuites! Travaillez au sein d’une entreprise dynamique et innovante, rencontrez des collègues et des partenaires passionnés ayant des expériences et des parcours variés Molson Coors est un employeur-qui souscrit au principe d’accès à l’emploi et nous invitons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, races, couleurs, religions, sexes, origines nationales, âges, handicaps, statuts de vétéran ou toute autre caractéristique. ai.title: Stagiaire – Gestion des demandes de crédits (Hiver 2026) Danone Boucherville, QC Salary not specified About the job L’équipe des opérations entrepôts joue un rôle clé dans la fluidité des processus logistiques et financiers. En collaboration avec les équipes internes (service à la clientèle, logistique) et des partenaires externes elle s’assure notamment de la conformité des demandes de crédits. Ce stage offre une immersion dans un environnement dynamique, au cœur des échanges entre les opérations et les fonctions financières. Rejoins une équipe dynamique où un défi n’attend pas l’autre ! Mission : Le/la stagiaire aura pour mission de : Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion documentaire et de suivi. Assurer la communication entre les différentes parties prenantes internes et externes. Supporter l’équipe dans plusieurs projets d’implantation technologique (automatisation, analyse de données). Effectuer des tâches de gestion au quotidien. Responsabilités : Collaborer avec les équipes internes (service à la clientèle, logistique) et externes. Rechercher et collecter les pièces justificatives nécessaires aux demandes de crédits. Analyser et vérifier la conformité des documents. Proposer des améliorations aux processus existants. Mettre en place des indicateurs de performance pertinents relatifs à la gestion des crédits. Participer à la rédaction d’une nouvelle politique de réclamations pour nos clients. Supporter l’équipe dans l’automatisation de certaines tâches pour améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle. About you Formation pertinente en comptabilité, administration, finance ou chaîne d’approvisionnement (minimum DEC). Maîtrise d’Excel. Une expertise en gestion de données (PowerBi, PowerQuery, etc…) et la connaissance de SAP sont des atouts. Rigueur et sens de l’organisation dans la gestion des documents et des suivis. Capacité d’analyse et esprit critique pour évaluer la validité des demandes. Curiosité opérationnelle et capacité à identifier des opportunités d’amélioration. Bonnes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite, en français et en anglais. About us Danone Amérique du Nord est l’une des plus grandes entreprises de produits alimentaires et de boissons axée sur la santé, engagée à innover constamment pour répondre aux attentes des consommateurs. Avec un portefeuille de marques reconnues et une solide présence en Amérique du Nord, Danone s’efforce de promouvoir une alimentation saine et durable pour le plus grand nombre. L’entreprise valorise la diversité, l’inclusion et le développement de ses talents, tout en privilégiant un fort engagement envers la responsabilité sociale et environnementale. Required Skills: Communication Excel Ai View Details

We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging - but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.About the SAP Internship Experience ProgramThe SAP Internship Experience Program is SAP’s global, strategic, paid internship program that provides university students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers.Three reasons to intern at SAPCulture of collaboration: meet with mentors, make new friends across the globe and create a thriving personal network.Project-driven experience: gain cross-functional skills from our virtual and in-person learning sessions, diverse subject matter experts, and project deliverables.Gain visibility: with SAP Internship Experience Program in your title, you’ll have a global network of SAP leaders, entrepreneurs and career development opportunities at your fingertips.What you’ll doPosition Title: SAP iXp Intern - Data ScientistLocation: Vancouver, BCExpected Start Date: January 2026Contract Duration: 8 monthsWork Hours: 40 hours per weekThe SAP Vancouver Labs is offering a paid research and innovation internship starting January 2026 for an 8 months period (with an option to extend by 4 months). We are looking for innovative graduate and undergraduate students who are excited about pushing the state of the art in technology legal compliance tools, pattern detection & classification and data analytics by drawing on research ingenerative AI,machine learning, natural language processing, data mining, information visualizationand other related areas.We offer interns the opportunity to apply their theoretical knowledge to explore solutions to real-life technical problems and develop tools used in compliance operations. Interns will work in the dynamic fast-pacedGlobal Technology Legal Complianceteam that plays a key role in ensuring SAP products and solutions comply with technical legal requirements such as software licensing laws and trade regulations. Interns will have access to support from world-class data scientists, domain experts, software development and user experience teams. We explore opportunities for technology transfer and publish in leading conferences. We strive to create an environment that is both productive and fun.We are located in beautiful Vancouver in the heart of Yaletown, steps away from a wide variety of restaurants, public transit, and downtown.Apply research to real-world technical problemsDevelop and extend tools used in Technology Legal ComplianceFollow up on latest trends and share the knowledge among the teamParticipate in project meetings to support project goals, requirements, processes, deliverables, and timelinesWhat you bringWe’re looking for someone who takes initiative, perseveres, and stay curious. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning.Education:Undergraduate, Master’s or PhD student in Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Mathematics/Statistics.Eligibility: Must be currently enrolled, or recently graduated (start date must be within 6 months of graduation date) from a coding academy/bootcamp, apprenticeship, associate, bachelor’s, master’s or JD/PhD program.Requirements:Strong research, analytical, and software prototyping skillsSelf-motivated, with interest in natural language processing and its application to real world problemsProficient knowledge of PythonWorking knowledge of prompt engineeringCommitment to 8-month full-time internshipDesired:Familiarity with using computer programming languages such as Java and C++Familiarity with deep learning and neural network frameworks (e.g., Pytorch, TensorFlow)Familiarity with using data analysis tools (e.g., SciPy, Pandas), ML technologies (e.g., scikit-learn, MLflow) and latest developments in Generative AI (e.g., LLMs)Experience developing user interfaces with HTML5, CSS and JavascriptMeet your teamGlobal Technology Legal Compliance is a team in SAP that drives best in class standards for IP compliance. We enable and accelerate the product innovation life cycle by advising SAP development teams across the globe.Bring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.We win with inclusionSAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone - regardless of background - feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for theSAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.SAP believes the value of pay transparency contributes towards an honest and supportive culture and is a significant step toward demonstrating SAP’s commitment to pay equity. SAP provides the hourly base salary rate range applicable for the posted role. The targeted range for this position is 24-35 CAD. The actual amount to be offered to the successful candidates will be within that range, dependent upon the key aspects of each case which may include education, skills, experience, scope of the role, location, etc. as determined through the selection process. SAP offers limited benefits for employees hired into hourly or like roles subject to appliable plan/policy terms. Are you curious about state-of-the-art technology? Passionate about starting your career in an environment that fosters innovation and enables you to make a real difference? Join our Engineering, Technology and Business Co-op to gain hands-on experience alongside industry leading mentors. Our Co-op is designed to expand your technical toolbox, grow your professional network,and bring your unique ideas to life. You will have an opportunity to build your brand within the organization and lay a foundation for your future career with us. What you will love about this opportunity Join a community of over 130 students and new grads 4 or 8 month terms are available in Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Toronto, Ottawa and Montreal TELUS' Work Styles program gives teams the flexibility, tools and support to work when and where they will be most effective - whether that's from an office location, from home or a hybrid of the two Learn from some of the brightest minds in the industry. You will have mentors alongside you every step of the way to help support your goals and growth Develop your soft skills and build a network within the technology community Receive advanced consideration for opportunities post-graduation Eligible to apply to the Graduate Technology Leadership Program (GTLP) up to 12 months before your graduation date Competitive pay, paid vacation, generous company contributions to TELUS Shares, discounts and perks on products and services Unlimited access to TELUS MyCare The TELUS Data & Trust Office (DTO) provides world-class, innovative privacy solutions to TELUS. Your contributions to data ethics and AI governance will support our business needs as well as our position on social capitalism as we seek opportunities to innovate with data. The research in data ethics and AI will contribute to an understanding of how technology can be used effectively and ethically, benefiting society as a whole. Here's how Conducting research and staying up-to-date with the latest developments in ethical technology design and development practices particularly for high impact areas TELUS conducts business in such as healthcare Advising on research practices and engagements, shaping the design of workshops to enable listening and learning from Indigenous communities Collaborating, researching, and writing reports to recommend best practices Effectively communicating research findings and convey the impact of ethical data and AI governance, and technology design, particularly for Indigenous Peoples web.title: Web Developer Intern Konstruct Digital - 3 Jobs Calgary, AB Salary not specified Salary: 20 per hour Web Development Intern (Paid) Want to learn from the brains behind one of Canadas fastest-growing B2B digital marketing agencies? Konstruct is looking for a Web Development Intern to work on real client projects, sharpen your coding skills, and get hands-on experience building modern, responsive websites. If youre looking to fast-track your career in web developmentthis is it! About Konstruct Calgary-based B2B digital marketing agency with clients across North America. Experts in search, paid, and content marketing. Healthy work-life balance and a team culture that values learning, curiosity, and fun (Thursday team lunches, foosball tournaments, and more!). We believe the company grows when you growyour learning is just as important as the client results we deliver. Follow us and geek out with our work: Instagram | Facebook | LinkedIn About the Role This winter, were offering a 16-week paid internship (starting January 2026) for a Web Development Intern. Youll get real hands-on experience developing, optimizing, and troubleshooting websites while working alongside experienced developers. Candidates must be located in Calgary and currently enrolled in post-secondary school. Responsibilities: Build, customize, and maintain client websites using WordPress and Gutenberg. Support front-end development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design. Assist with back-end tasks including PHP, MySQL, and plugin implementation. Conduct QA, debugging, and troubleshooting of web projects. Implement on-page SEO best practices and monitor site performance. Collaborate with designers, content specialists, and marketing strategists. Learn and use Git/version control for project workflows. Participate in internal culture eventsfoosball tournaments, office games, and team lunches. Candidate Profile Experience / Skills: Familiarity with WordPress development (themes, plugins, CMS) Knowledge of PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL/MariaDB, WordPress plugin development Exposure to Git or other version control systems Understanding of responsive design and website performance optimization Nice-to-have: Elementor, Divi or Shopify development experience Portfolio of websites/projects is a plus Qualities: Detail-oriented: you sweat the small stuff. Curious and eager to learn: you love experimenting with new tools and technologies. Problem-solver: you enjoy debugging and finding elegant solutions. Team player: you communicate well and collaborate easily. Passionate about web development and building high-quality websites. Internship Details & Perks Duration: 16-week paid internship starting January 2026 Compensation: $20.00 per hour Grant Funding: Venture for Canada Eligibility: Must be a full-time student in a post-secondary program and a Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or hold refugee status. International students are not eligible. Potential Full-Time Opportunity: High-performing interns may be offered full-time positions with competitive salaries. Perks include: Fun office culture and games (foosball, tournaments, office challenges) Fully stocked kitchen and free parking Work alongside a fast-growing team in a collaborative environment Portfolio Links: Please include links to websites or projects youve worked on. Required Skills: Javascript Sql Java Marketing Design View Details

Qualifications minimales Etudes universitaires en Informatique, Genie Informatique ou Logiciel Connaissance de base de C++ Experience avec les outil de developpement Interet pour la programmation 3D, la modelisation ou l'animation Creativite, flexibilite et esprit d'equipe Bonnes habiletes de communication, capable d'exprimer ses idees a un groupe Qualifications souhaitees Connaissance de base de la gamme de produits d'Autodesk (3ds Max, Maya, Revit, AutoCAD, Inventor et FBX) Connaissance de la programmation 3D et/ou graphique Comprehension de la methodologie Agile Connaissance de Python -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Here is an incredible opportunity to work with professionals who build some of the most advanced 3D animation solutions for Hollywood's special-effects, visualization specialists, game and film artists. The Entertainment and Media Solutions (EMS) group is composed of a range of software used by thousands of creators and artists in the media and entertainment industry such as Maya, 3ds Max, Flame and ShotGrid.This is a great opportunity to get front-line development experience in a stimulating environment. You will work with a team of professionals who will provide guidance and share their expertise in this exciting and important area of software development. Learn some new invaluable skills to push your career to the clouds. Please note that this is ahybridposition for Winter 2026 (January -April 2026 work term) Responsibilities Be an active member of our team developing features helping provide the best real-time experience and workflows for our customers using the latest in technology Participate in iterative design, testing and development sprints to refine the product solution.
